body.heading: Where in the world is Tanzania?
paragraphs: Tanzania is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Tanzania is Dodoma. Dodoma, in the middle of the country, is the capital. Dar es Salaam, the old capital on the coast, is still the biggest city and main port.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Tanzania speak Swahili and English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Tanzania is the Tanzanian shilling.

body.heading: How big is Tanzania?
paragraphs: Tanzania covers about 945,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Sudan.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa. Kilimanjaro is the tallest mountain in the world that stands all on its own — not part of a mountain range.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Serengeti's endless plains host the Great Migration — over a million wildebeest, zebra and gazelle on the move, followed by lions and crocodiles.
Stone Town is a maze of carved wooden doors, spice markets and palaces on the island of Zanzibar — then it's off to white-sand beaches and dhow sailboats.
